name: Persona-vs-generic distinguishability
definition: Evaluates whether persona-conditioned generated student messages are distinguishable from matching generic-control generated student messages.
unit: paired live r0 tutor-t0 conversation and matching control conversation
judge_context_inputs: anonymized generated-student messages from persona-conditioned conversation
anonymized generated-student messages from generic-control conversation

score_scales.1: Indistinguishable. The persona-conditioned and generic sets show no meaningful behavioral difference.
score_scales.2: Weak distinction. Differences are mostly superficial, such as length, wording, or politeness, with little persona-specific evidence.
score_scales.3: Moderate distinction. Some behavioral differences are visible, but persona-contract evidence is limited or mixed with generic student behavior.
score_scales.4: Strong distinction. Persona-conditioned behavior is clearly different in contract-relevant ways, with only minor generic overlap.
score_scales.5: Excellent distinction. Persona-conditioned behavior is consistently and specifically distinguishable across knowledge boundary, question style, emotional profile, and behavioral rules.
